name: Activity list
purpose: Show what happened, in order, with the context needed to trust it.
description: A timeline pairs an event, its context, and when it happened. Order is semantic.

guidance.summary: Shows what happened, newest first, with who did it and when, so people trust the current state.
useWhen: People check what happened on a record before acting on it.
An audit needs the order of events and who caused each.

avoidWhen.text: Work still waiting on someone is not history.

states.label: Default
states.description: Events with an icon, a title, a detail, and a time, newest first.

dos.title: Newest first
dos.description: People look for what changed most recently.

dos.title: A time on every event
dos.description: Order without time cannot be trusted.

donts.title: History open on a task screen
donts.description: Past events push the pending work down; keep them a click away.

donts.title: Pending work as activity
donts.description: Work that waits on someone needs an owner and a due date.

content: Titles say what happened in the past tense: Statement uploaded.

notes: A list; new events are announced politely when they arrive.

composition.defaultVisible: The latest events; older ones in a closed region or detail view.
composition.density: Five to eight events; the full log lives elsewhere.

redundantWith.reason: The same events as rows and as a list.

mistakes: Recent activity open by default above the pending work.
composition.responsive: Times move under the title on a narrow screen.
